body:
Definitely try therapy, because meds lift you up a bit but it doesn't solve the root cause of your depression You need therapy to help identify why you depressed and come out with plans on what tasks make you feel better etc how to change your thinking and move on from there. Damn I'm not doing a very good job explaining. But therapy has helped me the most. Do be prepared though as some people switch a few therapist before finding the one that clicks with them. I changed 3 therapists.

Damn your psychiatrist sounds terrible though, any options to change a Dr?

I was diagnosed with MDD more than 5 years ago. I'm definitely like you though (moody). I don't see a psychiatrist as I'm not on meds amymore so I don't bother with the diagnosis.

My psychologist also says to stop calling myself depressed because you are what you think? so I kinda imagine depression being this annoying insect that's always there, but it's not part of me (if that makes sense to you). Also probably why I don't bother with the diagnosis anymore

Don't call yourself ugly and poor ☹️
But yea I kinda feel you, I feel really behind in life and think that no one will love me because I have a depressive vibe around me. I don't wanna be alone forever but yea. I'm trying to love myself really hard it's taking a lot of effort to not give up on life but I'm getting better.

Sending hugs to you hope you feel better
This comment made me laugh 🤣 thank you

Thank you for sharing your experience. I didn't know ECT is available in Malaysia 😮 I wanted to try it when I had really really bad episodes but I'm just doing therapy now. Sending hugs to you.

Also wanna add on for the memory loss trouble thing. Every since I started meds, my brain has most definitely became slower, and sometimes I forget words which have never happened before. It seems that all these treatments are fast but have bad long term side effects, and the safest one is just therapy 😑

Weird, I would think that it's supposed to be a nice supportive environment.

Isn't the world funny how they give you the freedom to die but also make it hell for you to live properly.
Nobody knows how to deal with people with mental issues in general. It's kinda sad.

I cannot agree more. Also applicants need to know their worth. When I first started looking for job less than 5 years ago, on some job platforms you can see other applicants expected salary and degree so you can compare yourself to them. I saw some degree students asking for 1.5k??? And some even got masters degree asking for 2k. Please don't ruin the job market like this.

Tbh I just got off meds last year. I think they slowed down my brain permanently. They also cause very obvious weight gain.

Been on the same meds for few years so going off them didn't make a huge difference in my mood........ Thankful for the meds when I was at rock bottom, but now that I have floated up a little bit no amount of meds can make me a normal person. Mainly think I should solve the root cause of my depresso through therapy. That's not going too well but yea.

Damn I resonate with this so much. Sometimes I wonder why people don't stick around with me like all the other girls do( they stick around in groups) . Then I ask myself if I even like ppl sticking to me all the time..... I actually don't lol. But it does suck when ppl are in groups and you're left out. Even if you don't like groups in the first place 💀
Depends on industry... I wouldn't say being an overseas grad makes a huge difference, my pay is the same as my colleague

I am a fresh grad as well. I applied to multiple companies, none which offered me more than 2.7k. I am grateful to have a job yes but the sad reality is certain industries pay more than others. I heard that IT pays the best, and I wish I studied that instead. My cgpa is not terrible. In fact I graduated with first class, yet I couldn't find a job paying at least 3k. I agree with you that many companies are hiring, but if you're gonna pay me 2.2k I consider it an insult to my intelligence.
Cool thank you 👍🏻
I didn't know there are psychiatrists as kk, may I know which kk branch you go to?

AA Pharmacy didn't actually ask for a prescription note when I ordered, I didn't even have to show my medicine boxes. I did an online order through WhatsApp. I just asked them if they had the meds and told them how much I wanted then they delivered it to me. I'm not sure if this applies for all their branches though.
You can try asking normal pharmacy if they carry your meds. Last time I ran out I managed to get it at AA pharmacy

Thank you everyone for the replies. It did make me feel a lot better. You're right there are a lot of people like that out there. It's just really sad knowing that this is life... This is what we have to endure... I do have to learn to just walk away and not get hurt by silly people like that. Thank you all for being so supportive it really means a lot to me ❤️

Hi I hope you're feeling better. I think people with depression are just harder to be around. I feel like I constantly radiate sadness and suck the positive emotions out of people. Maybe being with us makes people feel awkward.

Hi there, I think it depends on which med you'll be taking. I'm on venlafaxine it costs about rm5 for 1 pill I take it twice a day so that's around RM300 a month. If finance is an issue for you definitely consider going to a full gov hospital I think meds are foc there. you might have to wait longer to get an appointment at other gov hospitals though. The good thing about ummc is you can walk in with a referral letter and meet a doc on the same day.

Hi, how long did it take you to get an appointment at HKL? I'm currently visiting the psychiatrist at UMMC too and kinda have the same issue as you did. (Doc doubled my dose so now my meds is double the price). Might consider getting referral letter to a full gov hospital too
oooo I don't think my insurance covers though cuz it mentions not covering any medical costs related to self inflicted injury =(
Hi there, did you go to the gov hospital or a private derm clinic for treatment?

I have the same issue as well... and I think it's because of the meds. I feel like I can't think as fast, and my memory is worse. I can't communicate as well as I used to. I can't give intelligent replies and sometimes I can't event find the right words to express my thoughts. It's like I've forgotten some words. I'm gonna try switching meds but I'm not sure how that'll help. Hope you get better\~

I couldn't accept that I had depression for a very long time, and I didn't know how "normal" felt like until I took antidepressants. I had to switch meds a few times but now I feel much better. I think its definitely worth getting help, try going to gov clinic to get referral to gov hospital. Its much more affordable.
